[[File:Card-Back-Light-Side.png|260px|thumb|right|Light Side card back, no-text print template.<ref name="drive" />]]

The '''Light Side''' is one of the two sides in the [[Star Wars CCG]]. One player must play Light Side cards; the other plays [[Dark Side]] cards. Light Side cards share a light-colored card back with the Rebel Alliance starbird. Premiere Light [[Character]]s are [[Rebel]]s, [[Alien]]s, and [[Droid]]s.

Printed English cards are '''63×88 mm''' (Euro poker).<ref name="encyc" />

== Card back ==

Retail Decipher Light Side backs are silver/grey with the Rebel starbird and STAR WARS branding. The image here is the '''no-text''' high-resolution back from the community MPC print-ready Drive, made for print-and-play rather than scanned from a retail card.<ref name="drive" /><ref name="reddit" />
